purpose: Shared hardened PDF-forensic core plus thin future-safe bank modules for nine banks with sparse original corpora.

fake_only_if: externally confirmed exact bad signature with zero original collisions
decision_policy.original_if: full analysis finds no proven hard evidence, including when the coherent official profile is new or absent from the sparse corpus
decision_policy.analysis_failure: If encryption/resource limits/unsupported critical decoding prevent any safe determination, output ФЕЙК with reason ANALYSIS_NOT_COMPLETED; do not claim proven forgery.

router_policy.issuer_detection: Use issuer branding, footer/legal entity, BIC/correspondent account, logo/stamp, and generator/layout coherence. Never route by recipient-bank field alone.
router_policy.unknown_bank: Do not apply another bank profile; run shared core and require explicit issuer evidence before bank-specific semantics.

rules.condition: PDF header missing, ambiguous, repeated, or preceded by non-whitespace/polyglot bytes
missing or multiple active EOF/startxref/trailer structures
startxref or xref entry points outside the claimed object span
non-whitespace data after final EOF
duplicate dictionary key before or after PDF Name #xx decoding
duplicate active object definition, object shadowing, or overlapping spans
xref active/free/generation mismatch or reference to missing/free object
conflicting incremental revision changes critical visible content
truncated object, unbalanced delimiters, or ambiguous stream boundary
critical Page Tree inheritance conflict or multiple effective roots
xref stream, ObjStm, hybrid xref, or new object graph
rules.guard: valid PDF constructs may appear in future originals

rules.condition: stream /Length does not match exact encoded payload
declared filter fails or strict decoders disagree
trailing compressed data, second zlib member, or unconsumed bytes
decoded image/resource size contradicts declared geometry
unsupported/recursive filter chain is used to obscure critical content
different compression level, framing, or stream order
JavaScript, OpenAction, Launch, GoToR/GoToE, SubmitForm, or ImportData
XFA, EmbeddedFiles, RichMedia, 3D, Movie, or Sound
hidden /Next or additional-action chain
annotation appearance or optional layer changes critical visible data
encryption prevents full inspection
new safe HTTPS/QR annotation with matching visible target
unbalanced BT/ET or q/Q changes interpretation
undefined or shadowed resource used by content
invisible text, text clipping, white-on-white, or off-page critical field
late opaque/transparent overlay replaces a previously painted critical value
critical field has multiple conflicting visible or structural values
text layer and rendered glyphs encode different critical values
negative scale/reflection/material transform used for substitution
CropBox/clip/Form XObject hides or substitutes critical content
render rows, pixel-row hashes, foreign stripes, perceptual thresholds
used CID/code is absent from ToUnicode or encoding map required for extraction
used CID/code is absent from /W or mapped width table
CIDToGID/GID mapping points outside the embedded font or to a missing glyph
PDF width and embedded hmtx disagree materially for a used glyph
duplicate/conflicting CMap mapping for a used code
malformed loca/glyf/head/hhea/hmtx/maxp/CFF structure
FontDescriptor metrics or Length1 contradict the embedded font program
Unicode mapping and visible glyph outline represent different characters
bidi, zero-width, controls, or confusables occur in amount/date/phone/card/account/ID fields
new font family, revision, subset prefix, full hash, size, or used glyph set
extra unused mappings or glyphs without an exact confirmed malicious package
full embedded font instead of subset, or many one-run subset fonts
CIDToGIDMap is Identity or non-Identity
amount is missing, malformed, visually ambiguous, or contains hidden precision
amount, commission, and total arithmetic is inconsistent where all components are present
date/status/recipient/account/phone/card differs between text, geometry, and render
label is paired with an impossible value or fields form a contradictory method
critical field occurs twice with conflicting values
issuer branding/footer/BIC contradict the routed bank
new field, status, commission, bank, BIN, phone/card format, or method
missing field that is only required by an observed legacy template but the new profile is otherwise coherent
observed SBP family requires an ID but the ID is missing from both text and visible layer
SBP ID is not 32 uppercase ASCII alphanumeric when that bank profile uses the standard 32-char ID
timestamp core encodes an impossible year/day/hour/minute/second
timestamp core is materially inconsistent with operation time after bank-specific precision/timezone rules
unknown SBP tail, new split, or new operation-ID format
rules.guard: tail is not a universal checksum

rules.condition: independent parsers extract different critical values
independent renderers display different critical values
parser repair changes the object graph or visible values
harmless line-break or anti-aliasing difference
same SBP/operation/document identifier appears with different amount
same identifier appears with different date, recipient, phone, bank, or account
externally confirmed exact malicious signature has zero collisions on originals
automatic blacklist training from self-classified files
exact duplicate or regenerated copy with identical critical fields
unknown producer/creator/version/object graph/layout/operator sequence
unknown hash, image, stamp, font subset, page height, or file size
file or method not previously present in the corpus

WB_BANK.sbp_id_policy: Current receipt does not print SBP ID; do not require it. Validate receipt number, phone, recipient bank, amount, status, and branding.
WB_BANK.future_guard: A future WB profile may add SBP ID, QR, or another generator; novelty is diagnostic.

OTP_BANK.sbp_id_policy: Standard 32-char ID in SBP receipt. Observed decoded time is +30 seconds from printed exact operation time.
OTP_BANK.future_guard: Both Quartz and mPDF are legitimate paths; do not require one global OTP object/font profile.

PSB.sbp_id_policy: Standard 32-char ID split across two lines. Observed deltas -6 and -3 seconds from printed exact time.
PSB.future_guard: Tagged PDF and full embedded DejaVu fonts are current-profile traits, not eternal requirements.

BSPB.sbp_id_policy: Standard 32-char ID. Printed time has minute precision; decoded time is within the displayed minute (+28 sec).
BSPB.future_guard: Opaque producer strings are weak evidence and must never be whitelisted as proof.

RAIFFEISEN.sbp_id_policy: New SBP profile uses standard 32-char ID; decoded time is within displayed minute (+15 to +56 sec). Legacy phone-transfer profile has no printed SBP ID.
RAIFFEISEN.future_guard: Two radically different original paths are confirmed; generator mismatch alone is never hard.

ROCKET.sbp_id_policy: Standard 32-char ID; decoded time is within displayed minute (+24 sec).
ROCKET.future_guard: Current PDF has 26 embedded CFF subset fonts, many apparently per run. High font count is legitimate and must not be a hard signal.

SOVCOMBANK.sbp_id_policy: Not applicable to observed card method.
SOVCOMBANK.future_guard: PDF 2.0 and Letter page are legitimate current traits; do not force A4/PDF 1.x.

URALSIB.sbp_id_policy: Standard 32-char ID; decoded time is within displayed minute (+20 sec).
URALSIB.future_guard: Current profile embeds full ArialMT without subset; full-font embedding is not suspicious.

YANDEX_BANK.sbp_id_policy: Standard 32-char ID; decoded time is within displayed minute (+13 to +24 sec).
YANDEX_BANK.future_guard: Current exact AST/object profile is stable across 3 originals but remains diagnostic for future versions.
